title.zh: 修订第920号共和国法（即《1953年公共工程法》）第一编B部分（e）目萨马省第（d）项第1至第16分项的法案
title.en: An Act to Amend Sub-Items One to Sixteen of Item (d) for the Province of Samar, Sub-Section (e), Title B, Section One, Republic Act Numbered Nine Hundred and Twenty, Otherwise Known as Public Works Act of Nineteen Hundred and Fifty-Three
title.orig: An Act to Amend Sub-Items One to Sixteen of Item (d) for the Province of Samar, Sub-Section (e), Title B, Section One, Republic Act Numbered Nine Hundred and Twenty, Otherwise Known as Public Works Act of Nineteen Hundred and Fifty-Three

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1955/ra_1254_1955.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Sub-items one to sixteen of Item (d) for the Province of Samar, sub-section (e), Title B, section one of Republic Act Numbered Nine hundred and twenty, otherwise known as the Public Works Act of nineteen hundred and fifty-three, are hereby amended to read as follows:
"(d) For the construction of the municipal building of San Antonio ₱25,000.00 "(d-1) For the completion of the municipal building of Catubig 8,000.00 "(d-2) For the completion of the municipal building of Palapag 8,000.00 "(d-3) For the improvement of the 6-room academic building of the Central Elementary School of Pambujan 5,000.00 "(d-4) For the completion of the municipal building of Las Navas 4,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 10, 1955.
